form_inputs.box_type: GUI / Workflow / Freeze Hint Intake Bridge
form_inputs.do_not_regress_rules:
New Local Freeze Entry must fill from project-local freeze hint intake when a current KANDA_FREEZE_HINT.json sidecar exists.
KANDA_FREEZE_HINT.json must remain patch ZIP root delivery metadata and must not be installed into the active project root.
Freeze hint intake state must remain under the selected active project root at project_freeze_after_update/freeze_hint_intake.
The Freeze Feature After Update tab must call the public freeze_hint_intake contract instead of guessing stale legacy workflow data.
The safe starter fallback must remain available when no current freeze hint exists, but it must not be writable without current validation evidence.
Preview Freeze Entry must remain read-only and must not write files.
Confirm and Write must require explicit human confirmation before writing governed freeze memory.
After confirmed local freeze write, the used freeze hint intake record must be marked used and AI compliance context refresh must still run.
Project-specific frozen memory must remain under project_freeze_after_update/frozen_features_memory.
Do not store project-specific frozen memory inside project_freeze_ledger.
After a local freeze write, the AI startup freeze context must be refreshed.
External AI review remains advanced/fallback, not the normal local freeze path.
form_inputs.feature_title: Freeze Tab Freeze Hint Intake Restore v1
form_inputs.known_warnings: This patch restores the local freeze-intake bridge in the Freeze Feature After Update tab. Human review remains required before Confirm and Write.
form_inputs.notes: The regression was that the tab fell back to manual JSON or safe placeholders instead of reading current feature metadata from the project-local freeze_hint_intake state created from KANDA_FREEZE_HINT.json sidecars.
form_inputs.planned_next_step: Install locally, run validation, confirm the latest freeze hint contains VALIDATION OK: freeze_tab_freeze_hint_intake_restore_v1, then freeze this feature through the tab.
form_inputs.validation_evidence_summary:
SANDBOX VALIDATION OK: freeze_tab_freeze_hint_intake_restore_v1
LOCAL VALIDATION PENDING: run the provided validation block before freezing
